title: Happy bumblebee
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD000'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#BFE9FF' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#BFE9FF' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(25 62 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#E8F8FF' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-25 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#E8F8FF' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(25 62 30)'/>
  <!-- antanae -->
  <path d='M44 26 Q40 16 34 12' stroke='#3A2A10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 26 Q60 16 66 12' stroke='#3A2A10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='12' r='3.5' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='12' r='3.5' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='28' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M25 52 Q50 44 75 52 L75 60 Q50 52 25 60 Z' fill='#2E2A4A'/>
  <path d='M26 70 Q50 62 74 70 L73 78 Q50 70 27 78 Z' fill='#2E2A4A'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 86 L45 96 L55 96 Z' fill='#3A2A10'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#2E2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4' fill='#2E2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='43.4' cy='42.6' r='1.3' fill='#FFF7CC'/>
  <circle cx='59.4' cy='42.6' r='1.3' fill='#FFF7CC'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M42 56 Q50 64 58 56' stroke='#2E2A4A' stroke-width='2.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#FF9E5E' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#FF9E5E' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
